claims: Alycia Baumgardner defended her WBA, WBO, and IBF junior lightweight titles against Bo Mi Re Shin.
Alycia Baumgardner vs. Bo Mi Re Shin took place on April 17, 2026.
Alycia Baumgardner vs. Bo Mi Re Shin took place at the Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden, New York.
MVPW 02 was held at the Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden, New York.
The fight was for the WBA, WBO, and IBF junior lightweight (130-pound) titles.
The fight consisted of 10 rounds, 3 minutes each.
Alycia Baumgardner weighed in at 129.8 lbs.
Bo Mi Re Shin weighed in at 129.4 lbs.
Alycia Baumgardner and Bo Mi Re Shin both made weight at 130 lbs.
Alycia Baumgardner entered with a record of 17-1, 7 KOs.
Bo Mi Re Shin entered with a record of 19-3-3, 10 KOs.
Bo Mi Re Shin is South Korean.
Bo Mi Re Shin's knockout power is 53%.
Alycia Baumgardner rocked Bo Mi Re Shin in the 4th round.
The card featured Shadasia Green vs. Lani Daniels.
